sentences.text: No, a Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on this floating rate business loan to an MSE with sanctioned amount / limit up to ₹50 lakh, and the loan is sanctioned in March 2026 so it falls within paragraph 261(2)(ii).
The documents do not state any exception for this case beyond paragraph 261(2)(ii).
